Hey, that looks nice! 
Im glad to hear you identify as an avid user and took it into your own hands to make a needed change. This is exactly what I hoped for in taking the open source strategy.  
My concern is that this approach doesn't scale. How will this be usable with 100+ partners? 
Maybe it makes sense to offer some more "first party support" for modded UIs (like we have official UIs directory for all of our projects) then we can see which ones are best based on popularity etc.  
### Suggestion
Ideally if there was a way to get a record of every task you were paid from, then we can save the amount of assigns per org in localStorage and sort by that order. 
We may be able to derive this from our permits saved in our database. Perhaps we can go by amount earned (which we will use as the basis of our XP score) which serves as a rough proxy for how involved you are within an org. 
That way, if you prefer to work on a specific org's tasks, they will appear in this carousel from most to least popular. 
The first time this page is visited or if the user is not logged in, we can hide this element. 
### XP
We have had this planned for almost a year but nobody started on it. Maybe this could be a catalyst to give it a shot to get started with.
@UbiquityOS what can you tell me about the planned XP features? Can you summarize all of the most recent plans?
Any update on getting this set up @gentlementlegen @sshivaditya2019

Shouldnt adapting it into an action be less restrictive than a worker, and as such, should be very simple?

Since we are using workers on a free plan they are limited to something around [10 ms computation time](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/#worker-limits) and workers cannot spawn other workers if they are in the same account, so that's something we should investigate I suppose.
